summary.title: Q2 Seller Operations Review — Apr 29 — AI Notetaker Summary
summary.content:
AI Notetaker — meeting summary
Meeting:  Q2 Seller Operations Review — Apr 29
Host:     Keisha Morgan
Duration: 14:00 – 15:30 PT (90 min)
Attendees (full window): Keisha Morgan, Tomás Rivera, Grace Okafor, Daniel Brooks
Attendees (partial, left at 14:35 for partner call): Jordan Pike, Mei Tanaka

— Assortment & listings —
• Lumen & Loom adding 14 SKUs for June (outdoor lighting line); Kestrel Outdoor adding 9 (camp cookware refresh). Daniel to stage listings by May 8.
• Listing-content fixes: 6 Lumen & Loom listings missing dimension attributes; 3 Kestrel listings with outdated hero images. Brand reps to supply assets by Friday.
• June promo calendar reviewed: Memorial Day event anchors week 4; both brands confirmed participation and funding.
• Inbound ASN timing: Lumen & Loom shipment arrives May 6, Kestrel May 11; Tomás flagged dock capacity is tight the week of May 11.

— Logistics FYI —
• Swiftline Parcel carrier talks ongoing; more next week.
• Ops all-hands moved to next Tuesday.
• Q2 seller scorecard recommendations due to Renee by May 30; partners get decisions through the official partner portal notice in early June.
• Returns-portal redesign: no decision yet; more after Thursday exec sync.
• May weekend coverage rotation: Tomás week 1, Grace week 2, Daniel week 3, week 4 TBD (asking vendor ops).
• Apr 18 warehouse-scanner outage retro: Tomás owns handheld firmware rollback; Grace owns escalation macro update; Daniel owns runbook update — target end of next week.

— Customer order escalations (internal portion) —
• Order HG-4418207 (Linda Ferreira): Swiftline delivery 6 days late; refund shipping plus $25 goodwill credit approved. Grace to close the case.
• Order HG-4420913 (Marcus Delgado, 1187 Alder Crest Rd, Tacoma WA): marked delivered, customer reports never received; probable misdelivery. Tomás to file the Swiftline trace and reship with signature required.
• Order HG-4409552 (Samantha Yu): third high-value return in 60 days; account flagged for return-abuse review, refund on hold pending Grace's write-up.

— Returns & refunds (internal portion) —
• Open return queue at 41 cases, up from 33 last week; late deliveries are the top stated reason.
• Return-abuse watchlist: 3 accounts under review including HG-4409552; Grace drafting the policy exception for the Yu case.
• Refund cycle time slipped to 4.2 days; target is 3.0. Grace to reassign weekend approvals.

— Subscription cancellations (internal portion) —
• 62 subscription-box cancellations this month vs 44 last month.
• Named cases: Dana Whitfield (two boxes arrived late, 'done waiting'), Robert Achebe (moved, carrier doesn't serve new address), Ellen Sato (item quality on April box). Grace to send win-back offers to Whitfield and Sato only.
• Root cause points to delivery performance, not product; ties to the Swiftline discussion below.

— Merchant terms (internal portion) —
• Referral-fee concessions: two competing sellers in the lighting category negotiated down to 12% (from 15%) for Q3; Daniel to model margin impact before we counter.
• Planned buy-box demotion of Kestrel SKU KO-7741 (camp kettle) over a 4.1% defect rate; effective with the June cycle. Daniel owns the defect-rate evidence pack.
• Hold all merchant-terms communication until officially conveyed; sellers should hear through the official notice, not through the grapevine.

— Swiftline Parcel rate briefing (CONFIDENTIAL — internal portion) —
• Swiftline is pushing a meaningful rate increase on ground and 2-day (range Renee expects: +12% to +18%). Carrier call is May 12.
• If it lands at the bad end, we likely pull the 2-day badge on oversized items and push standard delivery estimates out by a day in several regions.
• Keisha: 'this does not leave the room — if this leaks before Renee is ready to communicate it, it will be very bad for the company, for me, and for whoever leaks it.'

— Q3 fulfillment scenarios —
• Rates hold: keep 2-day badge → expand weekend delivery → start returns-portal redesign.
• +12% to +18%: pull 2-day badge on oversized; weekend delivery at minimum-viable scope.
• Worse than +18%: weekend delivery slips; team enters cost-containment posture; aggressively consolidate shipments to cut label spend (Tomás's call).
• Seller-specific packaging programs: maintain through contracted SLA; consolidate after.
• Returns-portal redesign: deferred to Q4 or later.
• Grace's escalation-team headcount ask timing: discuss Thursday — Keisha: case is about volume, not macro, but optics of timing matter.

— Action items —
• Tomás Rivera — file Swiftline trace on HG-4420913 and reship with signature; confirm dock capacity for the May 11 Kestrel ASN.
• Grace Okafor — close HG-4418207 with credit; write up the Yu return-abuse case; send win-back offers to Whitfield and Sato.
• Keisha Morgan — bump logistics leadership on Swiftline timing; submit Q2 seller scorecard recs to Renee by May 30.
• Daniel Brooks — stage June listings by May 8; build the KO-7741 defect-rate evidence pack; model the referral-fee margin impact.
• Tomás / Grace / Daniel — scanner-outage retro action items targeting end of next week.
• Keisha Morgan — share Q3 fulfillment planning doc with the four internal attendees tomorrow.

— End of summary —
